Hi all - I’m preparing an arXiv submission in math.MP for a paper titled Gleason’s Theorem via Busch: A Lean 4 Formalization. The paper formalizes Busch’s effects formulation of Gleason’s theorem in Lean 4. The repository and DOI are here:
https://github.com/markkasaurus/gleason-busch-lean

If someone endorsed in math.MP is willing to consider endorsing the submission, I would be grateful if you could DM me and I can send the arXiv endorsement code. Thank you
How much of the code was handwritten, maybe this could be in #AI authored projects ?

Note that asking for arXiv endorsement is very much frowned upon here. My personal opinion is that if you have to ask publicly for arXiv endorsement, then the chances that the paper should not be on arXiv is pretty high.

Moritz Doll said:

Note that asking for arXiv endorsement is very much frowned upon here.

Opinions vary.

Previous discussion: #maths > Private review request: Lean 4 reduction of Erdős Odd Coveri
Previous previous discussion: #new members > Question about arXiv endorsement (Lean 4 work)

Snir Broshi said:

Moritz Doll said:

Note that asking for arXiv endorsement is very much frowned upon here.

It depends on who you ask, opinions vary.

Previous discussion: #maths > Private review request: Lean 4 reduction of Erdős Odd Coveri
Previous previous discussion: #new members > Question about arXiv endorsement (Lean 4 work)
Previous previous previous discussion: #maths > Knuth's Torus Decompositions (m=4, 6) @ 💬

That is fair people do have varied views, ultimately though it is about where the moderation team stands.

It has been a bit vague in that regards too, because the initial verdict seemed to rely on a now seemingly discredited notion that it is against Arxiv TOS.

That being said, the only supposed paper here appears to be main.tex which is only 200 lines long.

Thanks all for the feedback; totally understand about endorsements - to be honest i'm more interested in sharing the output, the Arxiv submission is not important to me. If someone wishes to endorse, that is much appreciated, but i don't want to sidestep any process and i appreciate why the process exists. In regards to AI - yes, AI was relied upon as disclosed. I'm happy to post it in the AI Authored Projects if that's a better fit - was not aware of that group.

Yea it is just this channel is more for mathlib4, which has a high focus on maintainability and scalability, whereas stand alone AI projects tend to hone in on a specific goal and often lead to repos that are not human-friendly.

You should check out the repo merely-true , don't be put off by the name, it just aims to collect lots of things that are true but not integrated into a larger human-friendly repo.
